scope: Independent rendered critique of the revised local website; not human design approval or release readiness
summary: Focused follow-up resolves both prior findings. The bounded 320px capture shows the complete readable pilot invitation and footer. Fresh mobile evidence shows spaces between all three paired pain-heading sentences. No material finding remains from this critique; this is not human design approval.

findings.observation: After the FAQ and the beginning of the final purple invitation, the capture repeats the header and opening hero instead of showing the final invitation and footer.
findings.impact: This image cannot establish that the final pilot invitation and footer render correctly at 320px. It does not establish a defect in the live page.
findings.fix: Capture only the final invitation and footer at 320px from the current preview and inspect that bounded replacement evidence.
findings.resolution: Closing320.png, a bounded DPR2 capture, shows the actual complete final invitation and footer without the prior repeated-hero capture anomaly.

findings.observation: The paired heading sentences join without spaces on mobile: problem.The, arrives.The, and corrected.An.
findings.impact: The main problem statement looks unfinished and is harder to scan, although its meaning remains understandable.
findings.fix: Preserve an explicit space between the sentence fragments when desktop line breaks collapse on mobile.
findings.resolution: Opening390.png and the refreshed Page390.png visibly show normal sentence spacing in all three pain headings.

positive_observations: The opening explicitly describes recurring analysis and refresh after changed information.
Business pain precedes the useful packet, technology, workflow examples, demonstration and pilot invitation.
The desktop packet capture is sharp and distinguishes original evidence, interpretation, experimental prediction and human decision.
Technology names are paired with purposes; the scheduling, approved workflow, durable progress and shared presentation roles are visible.
Purple branding and readable dark text are consistent across the inspected renders.
Synthetic playback, unmeasured benefits, human authority and restricted source access are disclosed.
automated_checks: The builder reports Browser.json passed at DPR2; this critique did not rerun or independently certify those checks.
follow_up_scope: Only the two existing findings were rechecked; no repeat broad review.
capture_note: Fresh phone full-page captures are DPR1 overviews; bounded captures remain DPR2. Sharpness judgment uses the focused captures, not downscaled overview delivery.
